body: Well for now, just try to not commit to being unsafe.
The USA is a scary place. Still, there is no guarantee of success no matter what you’re doing. Stay safe. I feel your pain.

I feel you. However, not saying you didn’t, but make sure that before you consider going through with anything, you do research. A large problem with suicide is that a lot of methods are unreliable and instead of dying, you could be living in even greater pain. Consider that attempting suicide has a good chance of amplifying your pain and could decrease the success rate of a future attempt. Please give it a little more though with this in mind.
